The doctrine's round-trip risk printed as the aligned-sell ph3 give-back (-430) from the 12:48 high; the +1,530 high itself is reactive tail beyond the shelf and is not claimed. The blind's -420 was internally coherent and rested on ONE assumption it had itself declared untestable (unabsorbed flow, flow.price_free_absorption_proxy half-scope); the tape resolved that named branch against it. Exit read for 0701 (informational, not a required handoff): the final phase was ALIGNED SELL - the give-back was still delivering at the close, which is consistent with 0701 opening into continued softness (my 0701 blind -380 was right-signed on actual -500).

proposal_contribution: (1) SEASON-SYMMETRIC WEATHER SLOPE CHANNEL (extends Greg's S109 asymmetric-slope doctrine into the instrument layer). Rule: read the forward demand ladder on the SEASON-ACTIVE degree-day axis (gw_CDD in cooling season, gw_HDD in heating season) and treat its D0/D+1 slope as a standing daily lean input - rising = partial up-lean (heat adds some), falling = larger down-lean (mild kills big; the asymmetry is doctrine, never fitted). In g22 both band-authority instruments were HDD-keyed and void-by-construction (divergence_resolution gate (a) HDD >= 16.4 unreachable in July; shoulder_weather_band_void HDD <= 13.5 trivially satisfied), leaving the blind no slope channel: the -1,815 drift IS the unexpressed hill (realized cum +470 vs blind -1,345; all four down-forecast-printed-up days 0622/0624/0630/0703 sit on rising-CDD segments; forecast-D0 CDD ramp 9.06 -> 18.87). The winter arm of this channel already exists in-brain (the cold-ramp band family, G12-G16 evidence); g22 supplies the summer arm - the proposal is ONE continuous season-symmetric channel, plus a CDD arm for both gate instruments with its band bar left UNSET until measured on cooling-season blocks (no threshold fitted from one block). Requires the declared data fix (CDD at all horizons). n: winter side >= 5 groups in-brain; summer side g22 (block-level + 4 day instances); spans groups on the mechanism, and the summer-arm bar waits for a second cooling block by design. (2) CONVERSION GATE ON THE SLOPE'S UP-LEAN (the renewable subtractor, read correctly). Rule: the slope's up-lean must pass a burn-conversion check in grid_stack - est_gas_burn_bcfd/gas_mwh rising with the ladder = converting, up-lean earned; burn flat-or-falling while CDD rises (wind/solar spike absorbing the add, nuclear returning) = NON-CONVERSION, the up-lean is void for that session and a chain-sided down day may run its band (g22 0629: burn 38.6 -> 34.4 served while forecast CDD jumped 10.08 -> 14.82, wind +660,219 MWh +62%, nuclear chg_7d -1,443; session -1,160). Two mandatory caveats measured in g22: (a) WEEKDAY-NORMALIZE - at 2-day staleness the collapse periods were Sat/Sun; a weekend wind spike overstates the subtraction into the workweek (burn 40.2 -> 42.6 -> 44.8 on the very next slices as weekday demand overwhelmed the same wind); (b) ONE-SHOT - the non-conversion print is sold ONCE (0629 -1,160); re-firing it the next session against an absorbing tape is the 0630 miss (+780). n: three in-block g22 instances (0629 fire-correct, 0630 refire-wrong, 0701-0703 conversion-resume); the S109 audit names the same subtractor served-unread on earlier groups - coordinator to confirm the cross-group instance before promotion. (3) PAIRING RULE (who owns the session: slope vs subtractor vs tape): the weather slope sets the standing lean; the conversion gate may void it for a session; the TAPE ABSORPTION state arbitrates re-assertion - after a non-conversion sell day, if the next session's sell flow is being ABSORBED (flow_conviction negative-under-rising at ANY grain: exit boundary, failed seam probe, phase table), the slope re-owns the sign. Instances: g22 0629 -> 0630 (this day); cross-group absorption precedent G15 0318 (D-1 buy-absorption -> +1,900) and the G18 covering rally (doctrine_tier3.g18_covering_rally_s105) - n >= 3 spanning 3 groups on the absorption arbitration itself.
